draft.text: You came in because you have been having vaginal discharge that smells unpleasant and feels different from usual.
You also have soreness on the right side of your vagina.
We did not find any specific signs or test results during this visit.
Your symptoms may be related to a possible infection or other condition, especially since there has been a change in your relationship.
You will have tests for sexually transmitted diseases, including swabs and blood tests.
You will need to come back for a follow-up, and we will contact you if any results are positive.
